text:
```yaml
name: FPCUnit Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Free Pascal Compiler
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y fpc

      - name: Compile FPCUnit tests
        run: |
          fpc -MObjFPC -O2 -XX -gl -gl -dFPCUNIT -oRunTests tests/RunTests.lpr

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          ./RunTests
```
